# Ponte Modern American

> Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Steaks, seafood and a glass-walled kitchen where you can watch the chefs in their tall white toques.

- Phone: (813) 582-7755
- Address: 1010 Gramercy Ln, Tampa, FL 33607
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Steaks; Seafood; Plates and tableside
- Rating: 4.6 from 952 Google reviews
